contracts: Source tiles and every ground Path2D replay on the original visible Canvas context with no main-context clip.
One retained-context pixel capture uses exactly eight numeric source/destination arguments; both integer rectangles are identical, positive and bounded by the actual backing store.
The destination clip equals that rectangle and precedes copy composition, so pixels outside it cannot be cleared.
Retained context receives only main-canvas pixels, never source tiles or fill/stroke Path2D commands.
Identity full restore occurs exactly once after capture and before current route and final country/hole mask.
Whole-canvas captures are still counted separately by two numeric destination arguments; compatible streaming frames do not recapture the full canvas.
Original source coordinates, matrices, alpha, relative order and all tiles intersecting the copied rectangle remain equal to the separate direct-painter fixture.
Selected fill/border and administrative boundaries preserve path geometry, line styles, transforms and composition on main.
Existing actual-grid source-call reduction, atomic pair labels, DPR1.5/2, cold seed,22 invalidations, explicit retry, pause, budget and bitmap ownership checks remain active.
newExceptionAssertions: Injected error must occur at the actual selected partial capture or final main restore operation, not at fixture setup.
Both main and retained save/restore stacks are balanced after failure; main composition is source-over.
Complete canonical direct ground, world transform, current route and mask are restored before the frame ends.
Failed snapshot is released and disabled without a new surface, extra pin, extra tile request or tile bitmap close.
Subsequent redraw continues through the original direct painter without resurrecting the failed cache.
